statement: An approval records the approver's token id and issue time; at publish it no longer counts when that token, or every token of the approver issued by then, has been revoked since, nor when it records no token id (made before the upgrade, by an older instance, or with a credential without one, which cannot approve at all), nor when the approver's memberships come from the provider and either decision, on the roles it held then and holds now or on what the provider answers now, does not permit. Revocations that cannot be read publish nothing (503).
guards: control:ApprovalB2Test#an approval by a token revoked since does not count
control:ApprovalB2Test#an approver from the provider counts with the roles it holds now
spring-boot:ControlApprovalStarterTest#an approval by a provider-membership token publishes
spring-boot:ControlApprovalStarterTest#an approval by a token revoked since does not publish
control:ControlReviewFixesTest#an approval that cannot be checked again does not count
control:ApprovalB2Test#revocations that cannot be read publish nothing
